Community portal

Everything on this page is public. The sign-in form below is hidden until a reader opens it, so it never blocks reading.

How the reading list works

Articles are grouped by topic and updated every Monday. A reader can follow a topic without an account by bookmarking its page; the feed for that topic keeps its order, so a bookmark still makes sense a month later. The editor picks three articles a week and writes a short note about why each one earned its place.

Why we kept a public front page

Most questions that bring people here are answered without signing in, and a sign-in wall in front of them only added a step. The archive goes back to 2019 and is fully searchable. Signing in adds comments, saved drafts and an email digest, nothing more.

Accessibility notes

Pages use semantic headings, one h1 per page, and a skip link. Tables carry header rows. The contrast ratio of body text is 8.1:1 against the page background. Keyboard focus is always visible, and the reading order follows the visual order at every width.
